name: Moonlit Porcelain Pagoda Garden
description: A traditional pagoda garden where every element — trees, lanterns, koi — is crafted from translucent porcelain glowing under moonlight.
prompt: Night scene of a Japanese garden centered on a multi‑tiered porcelain pagoda. Cherry blossom trees, stone lanterns, koi pond, and bridges all made of delicate translucent porcelain with subtle internal illumination. Moonlight bathes the scene in silver‑blue. Refined, elegant, high detail, cultural aesthetic fused with fantasy.
caption: Porcelain dreams under the moon 🌸🏯 #PorcelainPagoda
